title: Similes
info: A simile compares two things using like or as.
As brave as a lion compares a person to a lion. I like apples is not a simile, because it does not compare.

questions.q: As quiet as a mouse compares quietness to
The moon is a lantern is not a simile because
options: it has no like or as

questions.q: Her smile was as bright as the sun
Type the word like or as, either one that similes use.
